Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Assistant (Tech.) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 03 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant (Tech.) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (BTech) or a related discipline, along with dedicated research experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant (Tech.) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Assistant (Tech.) post at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for the Project Assistant (Tech.) ranges from Rs. 39,420 to Rs. 51,420 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is via email. Candidates need to send their duly filled application form and relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What specific experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Preferred experience includes working with Indian languages in computational settings, LLMs, bias and responsible AI in multilingual Indic alignment, and foundational NLP tasks.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for this position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant (Tech.) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the application form?
faq.answer: You can download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website: http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is IITD/IRD/RM00109G_SN/ 540871.
